headword: {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}
gloss: reincarnation; cycle of death and rebirth

definitions.gloss: reincarnation; transmigration of the soul; cycle of death and rebirth
definitions.explanation: The Buddhist and Hindu concept that the soul is reborn into a new body after death, continuing in an endless cycle until enlightenment is achieved.

examples.japanese: {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}を{信|しん}じる。
{仏教|ぶっきょう}では{輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}からの{解脱|げだつ}を{目指|めざ}す。
examples.english: In Buddhism, the goal is liberation from the cycle of reincarnation.

examples.japanese: {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}をテーマにしたアニメや{小説|しょうせつ}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many anime and novels with reincarnation as a theme.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) composed of {輪廻|りんね} (samsara, cycle of rebirth) + {転生|てんしょう} (rebirth, reincarnation). A fundamental concept in Buddhism that has deeply influenced Japanese culture and appears frequently in literature, anime, and manga.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}を{信|しん}じる: to believe in reincarnation
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}の{思想|しそう}: the concept of reincarnation
- {輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}から{解脱|げだつ}する: to be liberated from the cycle of rebirth

CULTURAL NOTE:
In modern Japanese popular culture, {転生|てんしょう} (reincarnation) has become a hugely popular genre in light novels and anime, known as {異世界転生|いせかいてんせい} (isekai reincarnation), where characters are reborn in fantasy worlds.

RELATED WORDS:
- {輪廻|りんね}: samsara, the cycle of rebirth — the shorter form
- {転生|てんしょう}: rebirth, reincarnation — can be used alone
- {来世|らいせ}: the next life, afterlife
- {前世|ぜんせ}: previous life
